physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Twin Jet Nebula is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 0.09144 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/ESA Hubble 1997 image opo9738a; AVM sky astrometry (https://esahubble.org/media/archives/images/original/opo9738a.tif); catalogue reference hst-opo9738a
sources.distance: Sánchez Contreras et al. A&A 692, A151 (2024) (https://arxiv.org/html/2411.03825v1); catalogue reference sanchez-contreras-2024: 650 pc; Adopted model distance, not a parallax. Published expansion alternative:1300±200pc.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: SIMBAD lists no radial velocity for PN M 2-9 (queried 2026-10-01); the nebula is held at its catalogued distance.
